title: Rafters: A Free Basketball Career Simulator
author: agardner26
selftext:
Hey all, I’ve been working for the past few months on my basketball career simulator game called Rafters.

It’s inspired by the GOAT basketball simulator, basketballGM, but focused on living one career at a time, from college to the pros. I love to play it and so Im sharing for anyone else who may like this as well.

It’s free in browser, can be run offline if loaded up beforehand. We have an active discord community, frequent updates, and I would love for you to check out the game!

**Check it out:** [Rafters](https://akg123games.pages.dev/rafters)
